status: H1 MULTI-REGIME SPLIT -- derived from the frozen M15 manifest

derived_from.rationale: H1 spans 17.08 years and DOES contain bear regimes; it is the designated directional-robustness layer for that reason.

purpose: H01-H04 were tested on M15, whose authorised range contains ZERO down years. H1 spans 17 years with 6 down years and the 2013-2015 decline. research/VIABILITY_REPORT.md shows 1h|H1 is the only combination with substantial headroom against spread cost (9.37x).
oos_unlock_requirements: explicit written authorisation from the strategy architect
record the date, the git SHA and the candidate specification SHA at the moment it is opened
one look only; a revised candidate on a used OOS is a new candidate on a spent arm
oos_boundaries_unchanged: FINAL_OOS from_utc and to_utc are copied verbatim from the frozen M15 manifest. TRAIN is extended BACKWARDS only, which cannot reach the OOS window. Asserted at build time.

timeframe_roles.H1: primary feature/label research and signal discovery, 2009-2026
timeframe_roles.M15: replication only; its range has no bear regime
timeframe_roles.M5: not usable -- 0.4 years to the DEV boundary
timeframe_roles.M1: not usable -- zero bars in the authorised window

binding_range.basis: H1 -- primary and the longest usable intraday history

purge_embargo.rationale: the longest GO horizon on H1 is 4h = 4 bars (VIABILITY_REPORT s.2); dropped AFTER each boundary so no forward window spans two arms. The existing TRAIN/DEV gap is 81.0 h, already far larger.

viability.binding_constraint: every hypothesis using this manifest must cite a GO row and declare an expected event rate at or above its minimum

FINAL_OOS.market_stats_withheld: FINAL_OOS is locked; net return, median ATR and regime composition are deliberately NOT computed. Only structural metadata (dates, row count, index range) is recorded, which the lock needs in order to function.

enforcement: research/dataset_access.py raises OOSLockedError on any FINAL_OOS read without the manifest token
regime_warnings: TRAIN contains 4 down years [2013, 2014, 2015, 2018] and 35.47% of its bars inside them. This is the property the M15 range lacks entirely (0.0%), and the reason this manifest exists.
DEV is short (4.66 years, 27,589 H1 bars) and contains 2 down years. It can test sign agreement; it cannot independently establish regime robustness.

TRAIN spans a 4x change in gold's dollar volatility (2009 ~$950 to 2024 ~$2400). An absolute-dollar threshold fitted anywhere in TRAIN meets a very different distribution elsewhere in it. Thresholds must be scale-relative.

TRAIN is 11.33 years and DEV is 4.66 years, and BOTH contain bear markets (35.47% and 42.82% of bars in down years). This is the first split in this programme where a directional result can be tested outside a bull run in both arms.

The two arms have deliberately different benchmark character, so a rule that beats buy-and-hold in BOTH is robust rather than era-fitted. See research/BENCHMARK_REPORT.md for the per-arm hold benchmark that every candidate is measured against.
